atoms.span: The Marxists Internet Archive (MIA), located at marxists.org, is a non-profit, volunteer-run digital library
Works are transcribed, translated, and proofread into dozens of languages by a distributed network of global volunteers.
hosts a vast multilingual collection of communist, socialist, anarchist, and left-wing texts
The repository relies heavily on public domain materials or works distributed under Creative Commons licenses

observations.notes: The library composed accurately at the level of its sections, with a count from an earlier state of the site. What it leaves out is the terms on which it holds, available on its own Wikipedia card: a repository for Marxist and non-Marxist writers alike, which is what keeps the losing side of a split on its shelves.
